title: Green functions of the Regge-Wheeler and Teukolsky equations in Schwarzschild spacetime
summary: We present a calculation of the full retarded Green functions of the Regge-Wheeler and Teukolsky equations obeyed by gravitational field perturbations of Schwarzschild spacetime. We perform the calculations for spacetime points along: (i) a timelike circular geodesic (where null-separated points are not at caustics); and (ii) a static worldline (where null-separated points are at caustics). These Green functions show a 4-fold singularity structure away from caustics, and 2-fold at caustics (similarly to the case of scalar field perturbations, which we also reproduce).
